elements.name: old country bus interior seen from the aisle
steep forested mountain slopes in afternoon light
young passenger sitting on window seat in foreground
passenger cut off by frame edge, only back of head and one shoulder

wrong_setting: The seating is a U-shaped lounge with a wide window at the back and side benches along the walls, more like a tram or camper than two rows of forward-facing country-bus seats with an aisle.
notes: Repaint the passenger seated at a foreground window seat, cropped by the frame edge to the back of his head and one shoulder, face turned to the window and backpack on his lap; make the seating two forward-facing bus rows either side of an aisle; and fix his look to the sheet: darker skin, tighter short black curls, and closed-toe moulded plastic sandals with a buckle strap instead of sneakers.
